remarks: Welcome to Heights Crossing-Darien's premier luxury apartment community offering upscale living with unmatched convenience. Located directly across from the Metro North train station, Heights Crossing provides effortless access to New York City while nestled in a vibrant coastal town. This newly constructed 1-bedroom, 1-bath apartment combines refined design with modern functionality. The open-concept layout features wood-style luxury vinyl tile flooring throughout, living room bay windows and a spacious kitchen with Quartz countertops, an island, custom cabinetry, GE appliances, and a designer backsplash. In-unit stacked washer and dryer add to everyday ease. The bedroom includes walk in closet and is adjacent to a sleek bathroom with a stall shower. Designed for peace and privacy, the building features soundproofing between floors and exterior foam insulation. Heights Crossing will also feature a beautiful fountain courtyard with retail shopping below. Access to Noroton Heights shopping district, moments away from grocery store and pharmacy. Darien's beaches and Great Island are a short drive away. Community amenities include secure building access, garage parking, elevator, on-site staffing, a fitness and wellness center, a golf simulator, coworking spaces, and a resident lounge with trash and recycling chutes located in hallways.
